About this item

【Superb Motor Power and Long Range】- The MN-26 ebike boasts a 1500W motor (PEAK 2000W) for effortlessly conquering 30-40 degree slopes, can reach a top speed of 28+++ mph. It comes with a removable 48V 20Ah battery (with UL& BMS system) that provides an impressive range of up to 60-70 miles on a single charge. The waterproof and removable battery design allows for convenient installation and minimizes the risk of theft.
【Ingenious Design】- The MN-26 features a robust carbon steel frame with adjustable seat and handlebars, a step-through frame, a large capacity basket, rear rack, and bottle mounts. This bike is perfect for your daily activities, whether it's commuting, mountain biking, or leisurely rides.
【Ultimate Comfort & Enhanced Safety】- The upgraded 26x4'' wide puncture-resistant fat tires provide superior performance and a sleek look. Experience a smooth ride with an adjustable front suspension and seatpost. Stay in control with dual disc brakes and enjoy precise shifting with the Shimano 7-gear system. Stay safe with a bell, bright LED headlight, and brake light, even during nighttime rides.
【3 Modes for Versatile Riding】- The MN-26 features three modes: pure electric, assisted bicycle, and normal bike. Opt for assisted mode for long-distance travel with exercise. Customize your ride with five-speed settings. The LCD color display provides important ride information like speed, battery level, and mileage. Stay connected with the built-in USB port for phone charging on the go, anytime, anywhere.
【Gear Up and Enjoy More Storage Space】- The MN-26 bike comes with additional pre-assembled features. The bottle mounts, front basket, and rear rack have already been installed, allowing you to easily add accessories to your bike. Whatever the situation, the MN-26 e-bike is your ultimate choice.

[One-Year Warranty] - Established in New Jersey and proudly serving the US since 2008. Our products come 90% pre-assembled and include a one-year warranty on the motor, battery, and charger. For any inquiries, feel free to reach out, and we'll get back to you within 24 hours. //Please keep the original packaging for some time.

Product Description

Unleash Adventure with MN-26 City and Trail E-Bike!

Conquer the city streets and trails with our versatile electric bike!
Navigate through traffic effortlessly with our powerful electric motor. Say goodbye to frustrating commutes and hello to arriving energized and ready for the day.
Escape the urban jungle and explore off-road wonders with ease. With its sturdy construction and advanced suspension, conquer rocky paths and bumpy trails comfortably.
Ready to revolutionize your daily commute? Don't miss out on the opportunity to own our electric bicycle.
Embrace the freedom, convenience, and excitement it brings to your life. Get yours today and embrace the urban adventure that awaits you!

MN-26 Mens's Commuter Electric Bike——Enjoy Your Cycling More！

Powerful 1500W Motor
The MN-26 electric bike has a high-speed 1500W brushless motor for effortless hill climbing and a max speed of 28 MPH.

Removable 48V 20AH Battery
The e-bike features a removable 48V 20AH waterproof battery with a range of 50-70 miles and a charging time of 4-6 hours.

Bright LED Headlight & Taillight
Ride safely at night with the bright LED headlight and automatic taillight when braking.

Lockable Suspension Fork
The adults electric bike's aluminum adjustable suspension fork and seatpost absorbs vibrations for a comfortable ride on rough roads.

7 Speed & Dual Disc Brakes
The electric bike has 7-speed gears and dual disc brakes for versatile riding and reliable stopping power.

LCD Display, Headlight & Horn
The electric bicycle's LCD shows speed, battery level, mileage, and power assist levels. It also has a headlight and horn for safety.

26" * 4.0" Fat Tire
The foldable e-bike's 26" * 4.0 fat tires provide excellent traction on various terrains, including snow, sand, and gravel.

Detachable Saddle Bag & Front Basket
Comes with a detachable saddle bag and front basket for added convenience and storage options.
